TEAM SPIRIT

Tremendous team spirit has been a key feature off all the British League fixtures this year. When Pat Lyttle put in his best performance to date in winning the 'B' string 100m and 200m at the Warley meeting the first to congratulate him was jumps Captain Derrick Williams. This picture records Derricks only moment of inactivity as he amassed 30 points from; High Jump, Long Jump, Triple Jump, 100m and 400m Relay Squads.

One of the highlights of this years British League was the close dual between our triple jump specialists Dr,Aham Amadi(left) and Mr. Derrick Williams, which Aham won 3-1. Aham and Derrick won between them every A&B Triple Jump at all four British League matches.

Derrick Williams all-round talents have never been in doubt. Over the years he has been our 'A' string in the 100m, 200m, LJ, HJ, TJ and part of the 4 x 100 and 4 x 400 squads. He has even won the Surrey Decathlon Championship. In our last BAL Div.2 Match at Battersea he ran his first 400m Hurdles more of a series of hops if this photo is to be believed - and recorded a quite remarkable 55sec. in his debut. What if he took it seriously and cleared the hurdle and not the railings.
Jumping With style! Derrick Williams immaculate technique has now been captured in a series of coaching videos made for the I.F.A. which is to be distributed to over 140 Countries.
